name: Chris Pereira
one_line: British Canadian business leader, author and commentator with 20+ years in China, specialising in Chinese companies going global, brand trust and what China reveals about the West.
bio_short: Chris Pereira (彭家荣) is Founder and CEO of iMpact 美讯, a reputation and globalisation consultancy, and former Senior Director of Global Public Affairs at Huawei. With 20+ years in China, he advises Chinese companies going global and Western companies working with China. He is the author of Trust (《信任》, 2026) and Rebuild (《新出海》, 2025), a Forbes Top 30 Innovator and a judge for the CES Innovation Awards.
bio_medium: Chris Pereira (彭家荣) is a British Canadian business leader, author and commentator with 20+ years in China. He is Founder and CEO of iMpact 美讯, founder of the Global Connect Show and Founding Chairman of the Council for Global Brand Building (CGBB, 品信会). Before founding iMpact he was Senior Director of Global Public Affairs at Huawei. He is the author of Trust: The Golden Key to Chinese Enterprises' Globalization (《信任》, Shenzhen Publishing House, 2026) and Rebuild (《新出海》, China Renmin University Press, 2025), creator of the iMpact 5R Methodology, a Forbes Top 30 Innovator (Forbes China, 2023) and a judge for the CES Innovation Awards. He holds an MBA from HKUST, teaches at Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University's International Business School and writes the Substack Insights from China. He is based in Singapore and works in English and Mandarin.

signature_talks.title: Trust: The Golden Key to Going Global
signature_talks.summary: Why product and price are no longer enough for Chinese companies abroad, and how to earn trust with customers, governments, media and talent. Built on his book Trust.

signature_talks.title: Shenzhen Speed Goes Global
signature_talks.summary: How Shenzhen's fiercely competitive hardware ecosystem is reshaping global consumer tech, and what competitors and partners should expect.

signature_talks.title: Reputation Under Geopolitical Pressure
signature_talks.summary: Lessons from leading Huawei's global public affairs: the gap between consumer trust and institutional trust, and how to manage both.

signature_talks.title: How to Win With China
signature_talks.summary: For Western companies and governments: competing, partnering and selling with China clearly and without illusions.

signature_talks.title: The 5R Model
signature_talks.summary: PR as the hub that joins government relations, industry leadership, investor relations, CSR/ESG and HR to build a trusted local brand.

signature_talks.title: When AI Answers First: Trust in the Age of AI Search
signature_talks.summary: Partners, buyers and journalists now ask AI assistants whether a company is reliable. What those answers draw on, and how companies earn a place in them (GEO).

signature_talks.title: What the West Can Learn From China
signature_talks.summary: Openness, speed and execution seen from 20+ years inside China, and why the West needs a renaissance of its own founding principles rather than fear.

signature_talks.title: Western Brands in China: Start From Zero
signature_talks.summary: Why famous global brands lose Chinese consumers who have seen it all, and what it takes to win them back.

signature_talks.title: Inside the CES Innovation Awards
signature_talks.summary: A judge's view of what makes a tech product award-worthy, and how Chinese and global brands can stand out at CES and IFA.

signature_talks.title: Managing Across Cultures
signature_talks.summary: Practical cross-cultural management for teams spanning China and the West: communication, decision-making and building trust between headquarters and local teams.
